routes.title: Routes
routes.description: Pairs of IATA codes ORIGIN-DEST, one per line: airports (LHR-CDG) or metropolitan city codes (NYC-LON).

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Flights: every flight Google shows for each departure date. Price calendar: the cheapest price for each date of the range, one row per route and date, for price charts and monitoring.

departureDate.title: Departure date
departureDate.description: Date of departure, or the first date of the range. A date (2026-12-21) or relative to the run day (30 days, 2 weeks). Empty means 30 days from today.

departureDateTo.title: Departure date to
departureDateTo.description: Last departure date of the range. Empty means only the departure date. In Flights mode every date of the range is one search; in Price calendar mode up to 11 months fit in a few requests.

returnAfterDays.title: Return after (days)
returnAfterDays.description: 0 for one-way trips. N for round trips returning N days after departure; prices are then round-trip totals.

maxFlightsPerSearch.title: Max flights per search
maxFlightsPerSearch.description: Flights mode: maximum flights to save per route and date, in the order Google shows them (best flights first). 0 means all.

adults.title: Adults
adults.description: Number of adult passengers. Prices are totals for all passengers.

maxStops.title: Max stops
maxStops.description: -1 for any number of stops, 0 for nonstop only, 1 or 2 for at most one or two stops.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Currency of prices, an ISO code such as USD, EUR, GBP.

country.title: Country
country.description: Country Google Flights prices for (two-letter code, gl). Fares differ by point of sale, set the country of the traveller.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of airport and airline names (hl), e.g. en, de, fr.

trackPriceChanges.title: Track price changes
trackPriceChanges.description: Compare prices with the previous run of the same routes and options: adds previousPrice, priceChange and priceChangePct. History is kept in your named key-value store google-flights-history.

onlyChanged.title: Only changed prices
onlyChanged.description: Save only items whose price differs from the previous run (turns on price tracking). The first run saves nothing and records the prices. You pay only for saved items.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy servers to use. Prices depend on the country of the IP less than on the Country field, but Google limits frequent requests from one IP.
